description: Skip a post so it does not go out. It stays on the campaign and keep_post brings it back. Skipping a post that is already scheduled takes it out of the queue and returns its posting credit, and needs the schedule permission.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

idempotency_key.description: Send the same key if you retry, and the change happens once.

post_id.description: The post's id (post_id from get_campaign or promo_this_week).

name: skip_post
title: Skip a post
